stops.name: Königshafen
stops.detail: Sylt extends over 38.0 kilometers in a north-south direction and is only about 320 meters wide in the north, at the Königshafen near List on Sylt.

stops.name: Kampen
stops.detail: Its highest elevation is the Uwe-Düne in Kampen at 52.5 m above sea level.

stops.name: Westerland
stops.detail: The northernmost German island is known primarily for its spas Westerland, Kampen and Wenningstedt, for widespread nude bathing and for the approximately 40-kilometer-long west beach.

stops.name: Nössespitze
stops.detail: At its widest point, from Westerland in the west to the Nössespitze near Morsum in the east, it measures 12.6 kilometers.
